common.apiKeys.intro: A key grants read-only access to the public API at /api/v1/, 60 requests a minute each. A key is shown once, when it is made. Anyone holding one reads the API as you, so keep it somewhere private and revoke any you no longer recognise. Read the API docs.

common.image.removeDescription: It comes off straight away. You can upload another at any time.
dashboard.community.board.minimum.saving: Saving updates the board straight away.

event.addTournament.intro: Creates a double-elimination bracket to start. You can customise the format, then seed and start it from the Tournament page once entries are in.
event.checkout.cancelled.title: This checkout was cancelled
event.create.intro: You'll become its Host. You can edit settings and add co-Hosts afterwards.

event.organiser.search.label: Search users to add as organiser
event.payments.extra.help: Optional labelled percentages added to every order (e.g. “VAT at 20%”). They apply to all payment methods.
event.receipt.noCurrency: This event hasn't set a currency yet, so these can't be totalled. The host will confirm what you owe.
event.roles.hostScoped: Scoped to a tournament, a Host is credited as that bracket's organiser (a guest host) without gaining event-wide authority.
event.roles.revoke.description: Scope: {scope}. They lose what it lets them do straight away. It can be granted again later.
notifications.category.announcement.desc: Messages from the organisers of events you've entered.
profile.host.empty: You don't run any events yet. Events you organise will appear here.
tournament.advancement.intro: Route this Stage's finishers into later Stages by placement. Add a band, set how many places it covers, and pick where it goes; tick more than one destination to split it evenly (snake). Bands stack from the top, then everyone left falls into Remaining. Advancement is explicit: whatever a band (Remaining included) routes nowhere is eliminated.
tournament.criteria.blurb.series: the recurring programme it belongs to
tournament.projected.caption.projected: The draw played to seed: every favourite holds, until the earlier stages decide it.
tournament.projected.caption.projectedRe: The draw played to seed: the result if every favourite holds.
tournament.rating.noCommunityNote: This event isn't attached to a community, so each rating is labelled with where it was earned.
tournament.set.report.confirmNote: The winner advances in the bracket straight away. A mistake can still be corrected from the game log.
tournament.set.toOnly.deprioritise: Only a TO can deprioritise a player
tournament.settings.name.help: This bracket’s name, to tell sibling brackets apart. Leave blank for “{name}”.

tournament.stage.format.clearsBands: This Stage's advancement bands no longer apply once it becomes {to}, so saving clears them. Route its finishers again from Routing afterwards, or set the format back to {from} to keep them.
tournament.standings.provisional.body: These finalise when the stage completes.
tournament.tiebreak.third.note: Play a 3rd place match between the semi-final losers. It joins the queue once both are out.
